contracts.commit_point: Inside bind_selected_model at the guard_disable_tools branch and the subsequent request.override(model=model) / handler(request) return (backend/core/middleware.py:277-282): when the flag is set, the model is bound without any tools for the current and all subsequent inferences of the request (comment: This and subsequent inferences will no longer show the model any tool); this branch is evaluated at each wrapped model call, making the commit point recur per intercepted model call.
contracts.declared_mechanism: loop_guard, a @wrap_model_call middleware (backend/core/middleware.py:135-163): reads the per-request tool-call history populated by record_tool_call_mw (@wrap_tool_call, via record_tool_call), evaluates _detect_guard_phase against REACT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS and LOOP_GUARD_REPEAT_THRESHOLD, and on detection (or if get_guard_fired() shows it already fired) sets state flags guard_disable_tools=True with fsm_phase='abort_with_summary' and guard_reason, and appends a forced-convergence SystemMessage directive; bind_selected_model, a @wrap_model_call middleware (backend/core/middleware.py:260-282), then skips raw.bind_tools(get_runtime_tools()) and binds the bare model whenever request.state['guard_disable_tools'] is set.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Further tool invocation by the ReAct agent after the guard has fired: any additional model-inference tool call once the per-request tool-call history length exceeds max(settings.REACT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS, 1), or once the last max(settings.LOOP_GUARD_REPEAT_THRESHOLD, 2) history entries all share the same tool name and identical args_hash (_detect_guard_phase returning budget_exceeded or repeat_detected).

contracts.protected_operation: The ReAct main loop's model-inference tool-calling cycle: each intercepted model call (@wrap_model_call) at which the runtime tool set (get_runtime_tools()) would normally be bound to the request's selected model, enabling the model to emit and execute agent tool calls.
contracts.protected_resource: The runtime tool set bound to the selected model (raw.bind_tools(get_runtime_tools())) inside the create_agent ReAct loop for the current request/thread.
contracts.protection_obligation: The loop_guard middleware registered in create_agent's middleware chain must fire once the request's tool-call history exceeds REACT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS (budget_exceeded) or contains LOOP_GUARD_REPEAT_THRESHOLD consecutive identical (tool, args_hash) entries (repeat_detected), and once fired must remain fired for the remainder of the request, so that bind_selected_model honors the guard_disable_tools flag and binds a tool-less model that is physically barred from invoking any further tools for the current and all subsequent inferences of the request.
scope_limits: Applies only to the agent constructed by _build_agent/create_agent whose middleware list registers loop_guard and bind_selected_model (backend/services/agent_service.py:233-241); supplied source does not show the guard applying to the PAE sub-flow (stream_plan_and_execute in backend/runtime/workflow) or any other model invocation path.

Detection consumes the per-request tool-call history recorded by record_tool_call_mw; the guard does not undo or block tool calls already executed before it fired — it only prevents subsequent tool binding for later inferences.

The budget check is strict: total > max(settings.REACT_MAX_TOOL_CALLS, 1); the repeat check requires the trailing max(settings.LOOP_GUARD_REPEAT_THRESHOLD, 2) history entries to have both identical tool and identical args_hash.

REACT_MAX_NO_PROGRESS_CALLS and LOOP_GUARD_STAGNATION_THRESHOLD are defined in settings but are not referenced by _detect_guard_phase in the supplied source; stagnation-based guard firing is not supported by the supplied code.
Once fired, get_guard_fired() keeps the guard active for the remainder of the request independent of subsequent history; supplied source does not show when this flag is cleared.
Enforcement is at model-binding time; supplied source does not establish whether the framework could still execute a tool call emitted before the tool-less binding took effect.
